title: Basketball-Inspired Mesh Lace-Up Casual Sneakers with Rear Pull Tab

faqs.question: What materials are used?
faqs.answers: The upper uses mesh textile. The sole assembly is rubber + MD.

faqs.question: How is the shoe fastened?
faqs.answers: The shoe has a lace-up closure and a rear pull tab. The images show the actual construction.

faqs.question: Which sizes can I select?
faqs.answers: Size labels 36–45 are listed. Please confirm size measurements and your required size quantities before ordering.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order?
faqs.answers: The minimum order is 2 pairs. Please send the colors, sizes and quantities you need so we can confirm the order details.

faqs.question: How are price and delivery confirmed?
faqs.answers: Quantity prices are shown in the listing. Shipping costs, the requested color and size quantities, packing and dispatch timing are confirmed before the order is finalized.

faqs.question: Can I request samples or a packaging change?
faqs.answers: Please send your sample quantity and packaging requirements. Feasibility, price and timing will be confirmed for your request before an order is accepted.
